messages:
sam: Heads up — prepping QBR for Satellite (renewal ~45d). Can we do a short sync on slides + top risks?
priya: Onboarding health snapshot: 82% overall completion. Three active blockers: SAML setup, analytics SDK v2 not rolled, and one billing mismatch.
diego: I can take the technical slide (performance, KV cache gains, latency). Dropped a draft here: https://slides.example.com/satellite-qbr-draft — feedback welcome.
eleanor: Exec ask needs to be two lines: 1) current health (green/yellow/red), 2) what we need from exec (decision or resource). Suggest: "Health: Yellow — onboarding 82% with infra blocker; Ask: greenlight SAML escalation + 2-weeks dedicated eng time."
marta: I'll own the renewal risk slide + account exec summary. Can someone paste the feature adoption numbers (MAU, active prompts/day) so I can chart them?
priya: Pasting adoption query we run in looker:```sql
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as MAU, sum(prompts) as prompts_day
FROM events
WHERE workspace_id = 'satellite-prod'
AND date >= dateadd(month, -3, current_date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
sam: Perfect — Priya can you export weekly MAU and 30/60/90 adoption cohorts by EOD? That feeds marta's slide.
priya: Yup — exporting now, will drop csv in the thread.
diego: FYI technical risk: KV cache rollout saw a 12% error spike on canary last week, but we have a mitigation (rollback + patch). I'll put a short postmortem bullet on the risk slide.
eleanor: Can we have 3 asks for exec: (1) SAML escalation (2) temporary Dedicated burst (1-2 wks) to complete onboarding perf tests (3) ok to surface a minor price adjustment for advanced features? Keep each ask 1 line.
marta: For the renewal cadence, add "open points": billing mismatch owner @finance, SAML owner @eng-saml, analytics SDK owner @devx.
sam: Action items: sam -> coordinate dry-run + send invites; diego -> technical slides + risk bullet; marta -> renewal slide + exec ask phrasing; priya -> cohort CSV + short adoption blurb; eleanor -> final exec 2-line summary. Dry-run Wed 10am PT (30m).
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created "QBR: Satellite — dry run" Wed 10:00 PT (30m). Attendees: sam, priya, diego, eleanor, marta.
diego: Quick note on slides: please don't overload charts — single MAU chart + one adoption cohort table is enough.
priya: CSV uploaded: https://files.example.com/satellite-mau-30-60-90.csv — will also paste top 5 customers by usage in thread.
marta: Got it. Will draft slide by EOD today and ping for review.
eleanor: Can someone add a one-liner on support load (tickets/week) for last 4 weeks? that's often an ask in exec Qs.
priya: Support load: avg 14 tickets/week last 4 weeks, with spike during KV rollout (28). Adding to support bullet.
sam: Thanks all — feel free to drop micro-edits directly on the draft slides link. See you at the dry-run. :thumbsup:
